items.headline: US flights resume after nationwide ground stop
items.summary: The FAA halted flights across the US for hours, blaming outdated equipment. More than 10,000 flights were delayed and over 4,000 cancelled, affecting about 1.5 million passengers.

items.headline: Turkey and Qatar sign a mutual defence pact
items.summary: President Erdogan and Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim signed the agreement in Istanbul, deepening ties amid instability in the region.

items.headline: Tanker hits mines in Hormuz as UN presses Iran on inspections
items.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a gas carrier caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz. The UN nuclear watchdog called on Iran to reopen its nuclear sites to inspectors.

items.headline: FTSE 100 closes at a three-month high
items.summary: London's top index rose about 0.4% on Friday as investors moved into energy and defensive shares during a wobble in AI stocks. Centrica jumped 3.8% and BP and Shell rose about 1.5%.
items.source: Reuters via Euronext and Yahoo Finance, 13 Nov

items.headline: Microsoft outage stretches into a second day
items.summary: Server failures disrupted governments, businesses and individuals worldwide, with Microsoft 365 services only gradually returning.

items.headline: US Treasury warns against rate rises during energy shock
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent argued against raising US interest rates while the Iran war pushes up energy prices, though markets still expect a rise in December.

items.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI shopping agents
items.summary: Its agents can now buy things for you after a one-time card entry, with your approval needed for each purchase.

items.headline: Nonprofits sue five AI labs to freeze frontier AI
items.summary: Four nonprofit groups are asking a court to halt development of the most advanced models at labs including Anthropic, Google, Meta and OpenAI, citing the labs' own warnings about extreme risks.
items.source: Deep Gains and The Neuron, 13 Nov

items.headline: AI agent firm LangChain raises $300m at $3bn valuation
items.summary: The funding round was led by CapitalG. Its LangSmith tool for building and monitoring AI agents now serves 7,000 customers.
